about: The Undercroft, the old vault under the square, a room file v2 (the format: the builder's README, room files). Metres in the room's frame: x east, y north, z up, the floor's centre on the origin; 26 x 14 m inside (x -13..13, y -7..7), 2.6 m high (the plan's height for the cellar). Every prop, spot, portal and night light of packages/content/data/scenes/cellar.json is named below. Three ends: the crypt's in the west (bone niches in the old wall and on a pillar, the steep crypt stair up to the chapel), the well's in the middle of the north side (the ladder up to the well hatch, the bucket, sacks and planks), the Lantern's in the east (casks, barrels and bottle crates under the tavern's trap and its ladder). Three old walls divide the vault into four bays (G21's wall-pieces, D5). No window; pitch dark but for a brand by each way out. Grey boxes stand in for the pieces with no model (decision D2). A key named note, or <key>_note beside <key>, is a comment.
